brief: Demo example 3. Meant as a reward box that pays holders in ETH, nodding to slow withdrawal queues: 1,000 snails, open art, the one raise over 90 days, royalties into the pool and 0.2 ETH from the creator at the start.
shows: a creator buy above the advice
differences: Holder payouts (pay holders in ETH: "qStream": "PAY_HOLDERS_Q", "tStream": "HOLDERS_IN_Q") are Demo only for now, marked pending legal review (check that version with --network demo); on testnet once they are built (ref. slice S14), on mainnet only after the legal review. This draft burns SLOW on both sides, the nearest choice everywhere: it helps holders by shrinking the supply instead of paying them.
deviations: the creator buy of 0.2 ETH is about 12.6% of all SLOW, above the advice of at most about 5% (about 0.073 ETH at the one raise every box has): it keeps the example set's figure.
royalties are 1% into the pool, to show that choice; the advice is off, or 2.5% with the fees.

spec.description: Demo: 1,000 snails in no hurry. Withdrawals take a while; the shell is worth it.
